failed upgrade preserves the previous identity, data and migration ledger
changed checksum and newer unknown migration histories block further migration

workspace/project compound foreign keys reject cross-workspace environments
project slugs are constrained and unique within each workspace
session records require hashes, valid lifetime ordering and an owned workspace

public lifecycle contains no identity/claim material and never declares production readiness

expired claims and regenerated codes cannot open setup

owner creation rechecks setup expiry after preflight and hashing
login rechecks a password hash changed after credential verification

cookie authentication rejects bearer/agent alternatives and duplicate cookie/CSRF inputs
